correctness.rationale: The published rank-two Schur-cover alternating commutator gives adjacency determinant 0 mod p^a. For an isotropic R-submodule L of R^2, Smith form p^iRe1 + p^jRe2 has i+j>=a and |L|=p^(2a-i-j)<=p^a. All order-p^a subgroups are isotropic and a maximum clique S equals its generated subgroup. GL2 stabilizer condition gives p^(a-2k-1)(p+1) groups of invariant-factor type k for k<a/2 and unique even-a middle case. Independent separate two-generator subgroup enumeration for (2,1),(2,2),(2,3),(3,1),(3,2) found respectively 3,7,15,4,13 max isotropic subgroups, matching theorem.

value.rationale: Natural invariant of a newly studied graph class on a full infinite family of finite abelian groups; proves sharp maximum size, classifies every equality set and determines type multiplicities. Goes beyond published adjacency formula and a few examples.

limitations: Only homocyclic rank-two groups; general higher rank and unequal exponents not claimed.
Finite examples do not establish Smith-normal-form theorem; proof rests on structural module theory.
